summary.headline: Milestones and Season Wrap-Ups This Week
body: This week brought a nice milestone for Kylie Lambert, who passed 300 career assists as Arkansas Tech closed out its season. Several of the girls' teams wrapped up tough final stretches, including Roberts Wesleyan, Winona State, and Gardner-Webb, while Minnesota State capped things off with a sweep of Sioux Falls. Anna and Morehead State look ahead to Senior Day next weekend after a hard road trip at SIUE.

Anna — Morehead State dropped both matches at SIUE this week (L 1-3, L 2-3), a tough road trip for the Eagles. Anna keeps logging steady minutes at right side within the team's rotation. She and the Eagles return home next weekend for Senior Day against Western Illinois.

Elizabeth — UIC lost twice on the road this week, to Illinois State and Bradley, both 1-3. Elizabeth did not see the court this week. She'll get a good chance to work back in when UIC hosts Northern Iowa and Drake at home.

Gracyn — Gardner-Webb split at home, beating Radford 3-1 before falling to High Point 1-3. Gracyn continues in a limited role for the Bulldogs as a freshman middle, with road trips to Elon and Winthrop up next.

Breanna — Roberts Wesleyan closed its season with losses to Mercy and St. Thomas Aquinas on Senior Day. Breanna was a steady presence running the offense all fall as a freshman setter, and now looks ahead to next season.

Kylie — Arkansas Tech dropped its final two matches, falling to Ouachita Baptist and Harding to close the regular season. Along the way Kylie passed 300 career assists, a nice milestone to cap her freshman year before the offseason.
Layla — Winona State lost its final homestand to Augustana and Wayne State. Layla did not see the court this week as the Warriors wrap up a tough season.

Mary — Trevecca split its two matches, beating Mississippi Christian 3-1 before falling to West Alabama 0-3. Mary's steady blocking presence continues to help the Trojans down the stretch, with conference play continuing this week.
Peyton — Minnesota State closed its season with a sweep of Sioux Falls. Peyton saw limited minutes again this week, and the Mavericks now look ahead to the NCAA Central Region Tournament.

buzz.title: A Week of Sweeps and Steady Progress
body: This was a strong week for several of our girls, headlined by Anna Schiltz and Morehead State sweeping Tennessee State twice to keep their OVC push alive. Elizabeth King and UIC also rolled, taking down both Valparaiso and Indiana State in straight sets. No milestones to report, but plenty of good team wins to celebrate this week.

Anna — Morehead State swept Tennessee State twice this week, keeping her steady run at right side going; she's up to 23 kills and 17 total blocks on the season. The Eagles sit 9-11 overall, third in the OVC. She and the team get a short break before hosting Eastern Illinois Thursday and Friday.

Elizabeth — UIC kept rolling with sweeps of Valparaiso and Indiana State, pushing the Flames to 10-12 overall and 6-4 in the MVC. She's up to 39 kills and 16 block assists on the season in her rotational role. Next up is a road trip to Murray State on Friday.

Gracyn — Gardner-Webb had a busy stretch, beating UNC Asheville, NC Central, and Presbyterian with one tougher loss at Charleston Southern mixed in. Gracyn continues to see limited minutes, now at 11 kills and 3 block assists on the season. The Bulldogs are off this week before heading to UNC Asheville Thursday.

Breanna — Roberts Wesleyan dropped both matches this week, falling to Mercy and St. Thomas Aquinas. Breanna keeps steadily running the offense, now at 120 assists and 45 digs across 44 sets this season. The Redhawks host Ursuline on Wednesday looking to turn things around.

Kylie — Arkansas Tech beat Henderson State this week, staying solid at 14-10 overall and 8-4 in the GAC. Kylie keeps the offense humming with 249 assists, 63 digs, and 21 aces on the season. The Golden Suns head to Southern Arkansas on Tuesday.

Layla — Winona State split results this week with two losses, Jamestown and Northern State. Layla has not yet appeared in a match this season, so she didn't see the court again this week. The Warriors travel to St. Cloud State on Tuesday, and we're still hoping for her first chance soon.

Mary — Trevecca picked up a win over Christian Brothers this week. Mary's role has stayed limited this season, with 4 block assists and a dig across 16 sets, and there's no sign she saw action in this match. The Trojans are back on the road at Montevallo Tuesday.

Peyton — Minnesota State swept Minot State this week, staying competitive at 10-13 overall. Peyton has seen very limited time this season, just 2 sets played, and didn't appear to see the court in this one either. The Mavericks host a ranked Concordia-St. Paul squad Tuesday.

Elizabeth — UIC lost to Valparaiso (L 1-3) before rallying for a gritty five-set win at Southern Illinois (W 3-2). She's up to 32 kills, 9 digs, and 13 total blocks on the year, and that comeback win showed real fight from the Flames.

Breanna — Roberts Wesleyan dropped two road matches, falling to Queens (L 1-3) and Molloy (L 0-3). She's still running the offense well with 82 assists and 33 digs on the season, and the Red Hawks look to regroup at home against Daemen next.

Kylie — Arkansas Tech lost two tough ones, to Southern Nazarene (L 2-3) and Oklahoma Baptist (L 1-3). She keeps piling up the assists, now at 162 on the season with 42 digs and 13 aces, staying steady even as the results didn't go her way.

body: It was a mixed weekend for the group — Anna kept grinding on both sides of the net for Morehead State even in a rough Lindenwood sweep, while Kylie hit a nice personal milestone of 10 career aces during a split week for Arkansas Tech. Trevecca kept rolling with another win, and a few of the girls are still waiting for their first minutes.

Anna — Morehead State dropped both matches to Lindenwood at home (L 0-3, L 0-3), but Anna stayed a dependable two-way presence on the right side, continuing to add to her season totals of 18 kills, 10 digs, and 14 block assists. She's been steady at the net and in the back row all fall. The Eagles look to bounce back with a home-and-home at UT Martin next.

Elizabeth — UIC lost both matches this week, falling to Illinois State (L 1-3) and Belmont (L 0-3). She's continued to contribute on the front line with solid hitting and blocking numbers on the season, and the Flames now turn to Valparaiso next.
